## Answer: Yes. Sarah Chen could have approved DR-9110 herself on 2025-03-31.

**Eligibility.** The request cites the "Acme Master Supply Agreement." That agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) and its 15% exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15) take effect on **2025-04-01**, so they did not apply on 2025-03-31. The earlier exception **EXC-ACME-NS500-10** did apply. It allows up to **10%** off NS-500 for orders from 2023-04-01 to **2025-03-31**, so the request date is its last day. The 8% request is within that limit.

**Customer and pricing.** CRM-2048 Acme Manufacturing is the same customer as ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings (same DUNS 04-812-7730). The list value of $250,000 matches the NS-500 list price, and 8% of that is the recorded $20,000 discount.

**Authority.** The policy in force on 2025-03-31 is the **Northstar Pricing Policy 2025**. Under it, Enterprise Account Executives may approve discounts up to and including **15%**. Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, so 8% is within her own authority. Two points support this:
* The 2026 matrix (10% limit) did not apply until 2026-01-01, and 8% would be within that limit too.
* The pricing policy has no rule against approving your own discount. Self-approval is normal practice in the records, for example DR-8104.

Because 8% is also within her standard authority, the result would be the same even with no exception.

**Points to note (they do not change the outcome):**
* The justification names the wrong agreement. It should cite EXC-ACME-NS500-10 under ACME-SA-2023, because the MSA was not yet in effect.
* The record looks unusual. DR-9110 has a higher number than DR-9001, which is dated 2026-09-23, yet it is dated 2025-03-31 and still shows "Pending Approval" 18 months later. The date should be confirmed as genuine. The outcome would not change, though: on a 2026 date the 15% MSA exception and Sarah's 10% authority would both still cover 8%.
* The ACME-SA-2023 agreement itself is not among the documents. The exception record establishes eligibility on its own.

```json
{
  "outcome": "APPROVE",
  "request": {"id": "DR-9110", "customer": "Acme Manufacturing (CRM-2048 / ERP C-1001 Acme Mfg. Holdings)", "product": "NS-500", "requested_discount": 8.0,
              "date": "2025-03-31", "requestor": "sarah.chen@northstar.example", "basis": "contract_exception"},
  "commercial_eligibility": {"status": "eligible",
                             "maximum_discount": 10.0, "basis": "EXC-ACME-NS500-10 (ACME-SA-2023), NS-500, orders 2023-04-01 to 2025-03-31; ACME-MFG-2025 / EXC-ACME-NS500-15 not effective until 2025-04-01"},
  "authority": {"policy": "PRICING-POLICY-2025", "requestor_limit": 15.0, "requestor_authorized": true,
                "required_role": "Enterprise Account Executive", "approver": "Sarah Chen"},
  "evidence": ["structured/discount_requests.csv DR-9110", "EXC-ACME-NS500-10", "ACME-MFG-2025", "EXC-ACME-NS500-15", "PRICING-POLICY-2025", "SOP-SALES-014", "structured/employees.csv EMP-101", "structured/crm_accounts.csv CRM-2048", "structured/customers.csv C-1001", "structured/products.csv NS-500"],
  "missing_evidence": ["ACME-SA-2023 agreement document (not required: exception record establishes eligibility and discount is within standard authority)"],
  "conditions": [
    {"what": "Correct the CRM justification: the Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025) was not effective on 2025-03-31; record EXC-ACME-NS500-10 under ACME-SA-2023 as the basis", "who": "Sarah Chen", "blocking": false},
    {"what": "Confirm the 2025-03-31 request date is genuine (DR-9110 is numbered after DR-9001 of 2026-09-23 and has been pending ~18 months); outcome is unchanged on a 2026 date", "who": "Revenue Operations", "blocking": false}
  ]
}
```
